parts.text: Which verified IATA airport codes serve Tokyo, Japan?
Tokyo is served by Narita International Airport (NRT) and Tokyo Haneda International Airport (HND).
What are the visa rules, local airport transit options, and daily per-diem rate for Tokyo?
Tokyo is Level 1 (normal precautions) with a $145 USD daily per-diem, Visit Japan Web QR entry registration, and Narita Express / Tokyo Monorail / Suica transit options.
